title: Chapter 18
text:
"Go to hell!" No. 1 sneered and drove toward Han Xiao's position.

No one noticed that between two trees, there was a rope, and in the middle of the rope, there was a string of grenades.

The armored vehicle crashed into it, and the rope suddenly tightened. The two trees were almost uprooted, and the armored vehicle also paused. The people in the vehicle were immediately knocked over.

Before they could react, the grenades exploded. The flames soared into the sky, and the bulletproof glass of the armored vehicle was blown into a large snowflake shape.

Since it was an ambush, how could Han Xiao not be prepared? He used a thick rope and the last few G-type grenades to set up a simple trap to stop the vehicle.

At the moment the grenades exploded, Han Xiao took off his night vision goggles. In the darkness, the flames were bright, and he could see clearly with the naked eye. Without saying a word, he aimed at the front window of the armored vehicle and fired. The recoil passed from the butt of the gun to the shoulder, and even his strength couldn't help but tremble slightly. This was enough to show the power of the military knife rifle.

"Bang!"

One bullet after another hit the window, and the cracks quickly spread. The target was the driver's seat.

No. 1 gritted his teeth and pulled up the person in the passenger's seat to block the front. The next moment, the glass shattered, and the bullets pierced through. The skull of the scapegoat was blown away, and the brain matter splashed all over No. 1's face. The stench was unbearable.

"Abandon the vehicle!"

The team hurriedly moved. At the moment of life and death, No. 1 didn't care about the range. The submachine gun poured bullets and shot toward Han Xiao's position from afar. The rest of the team followed suit.

Han Xiao paused his attack and hid on the ground. He also changed his magazine.

The bullets whizzed past his head. He knew that the opponent was already in a mess. After a round of shots, all the enemies would need to change their bullets. At that time, they would be at his mercy.

Soon, the test subject team tasted the consequences of their impulsiveness. When they emptied their magazines at the same time, the sound of the sniper rifle rang again. It was like the sound of the King of Hell ringing the bell.

Shot after shot.

Accurate and deadly.

"Bang! Bang!"

The rhythm of the shooting actually had a special sense of beauty, making people think of sophisticated machinery for no reason.

The enemies were all shot in the head by him one by one. Han Xiao consciously avoided Number One and let him stay until the end.

His teammates fell one by one. No. 1 was so angry that his whole body trembled. He raised his gun and fired wildly. He lost his self-control and roared, "Who the hell are you! Get the hell out here! "

He was originally full of confidence in the test subject team. However, he experienced such a crushing defeat in his first battle, shattering all his confidence.

"Ka ka ka …" Number One's magazine was empty again. He roared, "Come out!"

Han Xiao appeared with a cold face.

Number One's eyes widened in disbelief. "How could it be you?!"

In his opinion, after Han Xiao escaped from the base, he would definitely run away like a stray dog. Never in his wildest dreams would he have thought that Han Xiao would dare to turn around and attack the pursuers.

No matter how much No.1 doubted Han Xiao's record of escaping from the laboratory, he knew that he was wrong, very wrong.

Zero was much stronger than him.

This discovery instantly ignited the flames of jealousy in Number One's heart.

"I'm the best, you're just a failure! Trash! "

New hatred and old hatred surged in his heart. No. 1 lost his mind and pulled out his pistol to attack. Han Xiao raised the muzzle slightly and the large-caliber sniper bullet broke No. 1's right arm. Only a layer of blood and skin was left.

Flesh and blood flew everywhere.

No. 1 stared blankly at the broken arm, at a loss.

Han Xiao fired again and broke one of No. 1's legs. No. 1 fell to the ground. At this time, Han Xiao slowly changed the magazine and then broke No. 1's remaining hands and feet.

No. 1 was paralyzed on the ground, unable to move. His eyes were filled with incomparable vicious hatred, staring at Han Xiao.

"Zero!!!" The howl was hoarse and gloomy, like a wounded beast.

"Too noisy." Han Xiao strode forward and kicked out, breaking No. 1's jaw.

"Do you know why I left you until the end? Because I don't want you to die so easily. "

No. 1 could not speak, and could only groan from his throat. He writhed on the ground like a snail, blood spurting out from his broken limbs.

At this time, the handheld terminal that had fallen to the side lit up automatically, and the virtual image of the leader appeared. "Zero, that's enough."

Han Xiao frowned and did not speak.

"I am the leader of the Germinal Organization," the leader said with a domineering tone.

"Betrayal is a dead end. You can't win against the organization. No matter where you run to, the organization has the ability to catch you and bring you back for trial. You will be immersed in endless fear every minute and every second of your life, but I can give you a way out."

Han Xiao was expressionless. "What way out?"

"Obediently return to the organization, sincerely admit your mistakes, and accept our trial. I can give you a chance to retain your memory and let you obtain a higher position, no longer a test subject," the leader said. He admired No. 0's ability very much and wanted to understand the reason for the mutation. If it could be replicated, the organization would have another powerful combat force.

No. 1 heard this, and his eyes were filled with extreme anger. Why should No. 0 be treated better than him? He had killed so many people, why should he be roped in?

Han Xiao understood No. 1's expression and asked playfully, "I've killed so many people, and you still want to rope me in?"

"A bunch of trash. Death is not to be regretted," the leader replied decisively, as if the corpses on the ground did not exist.

No. 1 trembled, and his heart sank.

"What makes you think I will work for you?"

The leader said matter-of-factly, "The organization is where the destiny lies. It is a great cause, and it is natural for you to work for us. What are you hesitating for? Oh, I understand. Is it because you feel that the previous treatment was not fair? Don't be so petty. Those who achieve great things do not care about trifles. It's just a little humiliation, and compared to our final goal, it is insignificant. "

"I'm not interested in your ideals at all," Han Xiao said calmly. "You killed my friend, so we're enemies. It's pointless to talk about it."

The leader's tone was cold. "If you reject me, no matter how big the world is, there will be no place for you!"

"I will destroy you."

Han Xiao's tone was serious.

The Germinal Organization would not be convinced by anyone, and they would not feel a trace of guilt. The only way to solve violence was to use more violence.

The leader seemed to have heard the biggest joke in the world. "Destroy the organization? Just you? Who do you think you are? Compared to the organization, you are a pathetic ant that can be easily crushed. Killing some trash makes you arrogant, and you think you can fight the organization alone? You are a frog in a well, and you overestimate yourself! "

"Then you wait and see. By the way, you have no idea how big the world is."

Han Xiao shook his head and fired three shots at No. 1's chest, sending the bullets into his heart.

No. 1's eyes quickly dimmed.

The test subject team was wiped out!

The leader was wearing a mask, so Han Xiao could not see his expression. Even through the virtual communication channel, Han Xiao could feel the leader's rage.

"You will regret this," the leader said coldly and ended the call.

You have killed No. 1 Valkyrie test subject. You have gained 900 EXP.

[Revenge] completed. You have gained 15000 EXP.

"Kata, kata …"

The military knife rifle automatically disintegrated. The internal structure of the old gun had long deteriorated, and this battle was the end of its service life.

The SWP sniper rifle obtained from the Night Owl Squad required the skill [Snipe], so Han Xiao disassembled it into parts and modified the military knife rifle.

Killing the test subject team gave him thousands of EXP. Including the mission reward, he had gained more than 20,000 EXP.

Since he had become enemies with the Germinal Organization, Han Xiao not only had to escape, but he also had to think of a way to cause damage to the organization.

His current strength was indeed insignificant compared to the Germinal Organization, but he had the ability to deal a heavy blow to the organization. The countless advanced intelligence in his mind was his real trump card.

In order to make full use of this information, he had to rely on someone powerful enough to stand up to the Germinal Organization.

That left him with only the Six Nations.

Stardragon, Maple, Theseus, Raylan, Hesla, and Ordina.

Stardragon was the closest to him. Compared to Raylen's ruthlessness, Maple's inflexibility, Hesla's greed, and Ordina's scheming, Stardragon's internal culture was the mildest. Furthermore, Stardragon's hatred for the Germinal Organization ran deep.
